what_it_does: Diff-MoE optimizes inference (running pre-trained models) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models where many specialized sub-models (experts) work together on GPUs. Since storing all experts exceeds GPU memory, Diff-MoE uses a three-tier cache hierarchy: the most frequently used experts stay in fast GPU cache; moderately used experts sit in medium-priority cache with predictive loading; rarely used experts load on-demand from slower memory. This reduces communication delays during batched inference.
